scope: Re-audit and functional replay of earlier generated RTL, plus new OOC synthesis

conditions.single_agent: one fresh Agent, ordinary specification and self-verification, no explicit contract
conditions.contract_based: one fresh Agent, structured contract freeze + structural gate before RTL, self-verification

functional_pass_requires: Official analyzer dot AND compile/simulation exit zero, no external timeout

synthesis.clock_policy: Original DUT clk/clock ports at 5ns; virtual 5ns clock when absent
synthesis.io_delay_policy: max 2.5ns, min 0ns; no pin placement or board IO timing claims

limitations: One fresh sample per task per arm; no repeated-run variance estimate
Both conditions use one Agent; not a multi-Agent comparison
Contract arm includes an additional contract skill; compares workflow as a whole
Benchmark-adapted module contract; no accelerator ISA/bank/board evidence
Instruction-separated filesystem access, not hard read isolation
Earlier run used different debugging environment and budget; not a controlled before/after ablation
Captured RTL reused; not a fresh generation or evaluation of current full LLM2RTL
Reference-failing tasks retained in 156-task primary denominator
Synthesis timing reports are diagnostic; no routed timing or board-runtime claim
No MAGE rerun, VerilogEval v1, CVDP, accelerator integration, or measured TOPS/W in this run
